svg.title: AI Jewellery Design — architecture
svg.desc: AI Jewellery Design: Sketch-to-design generation with a Pix2Pix GAN · Python · TensorFlow · OpenCV. Turning a jewellery sketch into a realistic concept can take a CAD artist hours. This project trains a Pix2Pix conditional GAN on paired sketches and images, so a new sketch becomes a design concept in a single pass.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: styles can produce blurry or odd results for sketches unlike anything it

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
